class.name: SemanticAssetIndex
class.brief_description: Lexical semantic index for tagged project assets.
class.description: Builds and queries a lightweight token index from asset tags and metadata. Used by JustAMCP semantic search tools.

method.name: begin_batch
method.description: Starts a nested index batch so multiple upserts or removals can be saved together.

method.name: commit_batch
method.description: Ends one batch level and schedules a deferred save when the outermost batch closes.

method.name: find_similar
method.description: Finds assets similar to the indexed asset at [param path].

method.name: find_similar_with_filters
method.description: Finds assets similar to [param path], optionally filtered by [param path_regex] and [param class_filter].

method.name: get_asset_entry
method.description: Returns index entry details for an asset path.

method.name: load
method.description: Loads the persisted index from disk.

method.name: rebuild_index
method.description: Rebuilds the index from asset tags.

method.name: remove_entry
method.description: Removes one asset from the index.

method.name: remove_paths
method.description: Removes each path in [param paths] from the index inside a batch.

method.name: search
method.description: Searches indexed assets by lexical query.

method.name: search_filtered
method.description: Searches indexed assets for [param query], optionally requiring matches against [param tags].

method.name: search_with_filters
method.description: Searches indexed assets with tag, path regex, and class filters applied to the results.

method.name: upsert_entry
method.description: Upserts one asset into the index.

method.name: upsert_paths
method.description: Upserts each path in [param paths] into the index inside a batch.
